## Purpose

State what decisions this assessment supports and what it does **not** certify.
For diagnostics, make clear that the result guides study rather than assigning
a grade.

## Instructions

- State timing, allowed resources, answer format, and feedback timing.
- Explain how to save or export completion without storing raw answers.
- Describe accessibility alternatives and how to use a static version.
- List the covered outcomes and skill-mode balance.

## Assessment

Reference one validated quiz bank or embed questions that compile to the same
internal model. Use stable IDs and explicit validation policies. Do not expose
answers before checking in an interactive version.

```html
<!-- Example: <fc-quiz data-source="../../quizzes/pathway/diagnostic.yml"></fc-quiz> -->
```

## Results and interpretation

Explain performance by outcome or course, not as a single misleading score.
Give concrete review routes and distinguish conceptual gaps from calculation or
tool-use gaps.

## Solutions

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Static solutions and explanations"}
Provide a renderer-independent fallback with complete explanations. For a timed
assessment, place this after the attempt section and label feedback as deferred.
:::

## Next step

Link the recommended course sequence, targeted lessons, and cumulative practice.
